home.problemsTitle: Why Do SC Concessional Applications Fail Today?
home.problemsSubtitle: Beneficiaries with family income under ₹5L/year are legally entitled to subsidized capital, but face hurdles:
home.problem1Desc: Applicants apply for Term Loans when their project fits Micro Finance (≤ ₹1.4L), or miss out on women schemes like Mahila Samriddhi at 5% rate.
home.problem1Solved: Solved: Automated rule engine ranks by exact eligibility.
home.problem2Desc: Submitting files to bank branches that don't handle NSFDC or have exhausted their annual allocation causes months of rejection delays.
home.problem2Solved: Solved: Geo-spatial locator filters healthy partners with fund capacity.
home.problem3Desc: Borrowers are unaware that concessional loans include 3-12 months grace periods where no principal is due while their business takes off.
home.problem3Solved: Solved: Dynamic simulator shows exact savings vs commercial loans.
